regimens.indication: Status Epilepticus & Severe Recurrent Convulsive Seizures (Adult)

refs.quote: Diazepam injection is a useful adjunct in status epilepticus.

5 mg to 10 mg initially (intravenous preferred). This injection may be repeated if necessary at 10 to 15 minute intervals up to a maximum dose of 30 mg. If necessary, therapy with diazepam may be repeated in 2 to 4 hours; however, residual active metabolites may persist, and readministration should be made with this consideration.

regimens.dose_text: 5 mg to 10 mg IV slowly (at least 1 min per 5 mg). May repeat every 10 to 15 minutes as needed up to a maximum cumulative dose of 30 mg. Therapy may be repeated in 2 to 4 hours if necessary.

refs.quote: Children 3 months up to 17 years of age with status epilepticus: First dose: 0.2 mg/kg (maximum 8 mg) by slow intravenous push (one minute in duration). hepatic.note: Extensively metabolized by hepatic CYP2C19 and CYP3A4; half-life prolonged and clearance decreased in hepatic impairment and cirrhosis; use with caution and lower doses
